measurement_priority: stimulus-specific IMAGERY RELIABILITY on reproducible data (NOT decoder accuracy, reconstruction quality, or published headline performance)

d1_minimal_reliability_subset.source: KamitaniLab figshare preprocessed bdpy (VC ROI + V1-V4 metadata + stimulus labels), DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.7033577.v16
d1_minimal_reliability_subset.rationale: the OpenNeuro BIDS is raw BOLD with no ROI masks; the figshare preprocessed VC release is the field-standard, small (~460 MB total), and carries the official visual ROIs and per-sample stimulus/run labels needed for a reliability screen without a custom preprocessing pipeline.
d1_minimal_reliability_subset.raw_openneuro_alternative: s3://openneuro.org/ds001506 (raw BOLD, ~183 MB/run) if bdpy reprocessing were required; not used in this gate.

d2.note: acquired ONLY if D1 prospectively fails; semantic/video-recall paradigm with verbal-cue confound

d3.access: BLOCKED_ACCESS (not located on OpenNeuro; author request required)
d3.note: restricted topographic geometry only; not acquired in this gate

integrity_policy: .part + atomic rename + MD5 (figshare) + HDF5 open + shape/label certification; no raw neural data in git
